text: {"claims":[{"cid":"c1","text":"Nuclear plants produce no greenhouse gases during operation.","cited_pids":["8ef6c9360938#3"]},{"cid":"c2","text":"Nuclear power's life-cycle emissions are similar to wind and about one-third of solar per unit of electricity.","cited_pids":["8ef6c9360938#3"]},{"cid":"c3","text":"The IAEA links higher nuclear output, alongside renewables and coal-to-gas switching, to levelling global CO2 emissions.","cited_pids":["7e88e103d8fb#0"]},{"cid":"c4","text":"A cross-country study of 16 nuclear countries found nuclear generation can cut CO2 at lower cost than renewables, even counting accident risks.","cited_pids":["946b45d61e84#0"]},{"cid":"c5","text":"An analysis reports average nuclear construction cost overruns of about 102.5% and extreme delays.","cited_pids":["06384d0fb532#2"]},{"cid":"c6","text":"A Swedish model found little cost benefit in reinvesting in nuclear once existing plants close.","cited_pids":["6b0ccdbcf9aa#1"]},{"cid":"c7","text":"Opponents of nuclear power cite health, accident and waste risks.","cited_pids":["4e9b20313655#3"]},{"cid":"c8","text":"Nuclear is a strong low-carbon option on emissions, but cost and delivery risks weaken its case relative to cheaper renewables in some settings.","cited_pids":[]}]}
